title: TTPPreliminaryRepeatabilityStudy
description: One bounded preliminary repeatability study: a single instrument, a single measurement point, repeated captures, and the descriptive spread of the valid ones. Reports repeatability only. Agreement with a reference method is not established here and cannot be inferred from these numbers.

evidence_origin.description: Only HARDWARE may be described as hardware evidence. FIXTURE and SYNTHETIC prove the contract and analysis path, not instrument behavior.

reference_structure_id.description: What the rig was driving. A rig-characterization experiment records the rig in instrument_id, so the body under the stinger is named here instead.

excitation.description: The mechanical excitation arrangement. manual_tap is one permitted method, not the canonical one; the field is open so a future excitation architecture is recordable without a schema change.

excitation_contract_id.description: Links to an ExcitationContractV1 when a driven source is used

stinger_id.description: The stinger between the driver and the specimen. It is part of the measurement instrument: swapping it changes the mechanical path in and is a configuration change, not a repeat.

contact_tip_id.description: The tip in contact with the specimen, identified separately from the stinger for the same reason.

rig_configuration_id.description: The assembled combination of driver, stinger, tip, fixture, and support. Names one configuration so two runs can be told apart.

stinger_mass_g.description: Measured stinger mass. Measured rather than estimated, and never compared against a limit.

combined_contact_mass_g.description: A separate measurement of what moves with the specimen, not the sum of the two parts above: what moves is not always the whole stinger.

runs.description: Every capture attempt, valid and rejected. Rejected runs are accounted for here and excluded from the metrics.

observed_features.description: Spectral feature candidates and derived quantities. Not identified structural modes.

sequence_index.description: Where this run sat in the acquisition order, as the acquisition recorded it. Warm-up, contact creep, and transducer drift are only visible in sequence, and reconstructing that order later by sorting timestamps is a guess.

metrics.description: Descriptive spread of each summarized quantity across the valid runs. No acceptance flag, threshold, or verdict field exists here by design.

source_run_ids.description: Every valid run contributing to this statistic, so the number is traceable to its source evidence

limitations.description: What this study does not establish. Required whenever metrics are reported.

referenced_repeatability_evidence_ids.description: Cross-reference to any DO-085 repeatability_evidence_v1 record covering the same runs. Informational: this study does not inherit that record's acceptance gate and validates without it.

environment.description: Recorded conditions. null means unknown and stays unknown; no temperature or humidity normalization is applied anywhere.

acquisition_channel.description: One recorded acquisition channel. The quantity and unit are what make a transfer function's own units derivable rather than assumed: an acoustic pressure response over a measured force is Pa/N, and the same arithmetic over two microphones is a ratio and nothing more.

sensitivity_value.description: The sensor's stated sensitivity. Recorded with its own unit and never assumed: no sensitivity or unit is fixed in advance of choosing a transducer.

sensitivity_unit.description: The unit sensitivity_value is expressed in, as the device states it.

calibration_traceability.description: How far the scaling to engineering units can be defended. Measured is not traceable: NOMINAL is a specification value taken on trust, TRACEABLE is an unbroken chain to a reference and requires calibration_reference, and UNKNOWN is the default because a sensor whose calibration nobody recorded has none this repository can attest to.

calibration_reference.description: The certificate or record a TRACEABLE claim rests on.

campaign_condition.description: The physical state one hardware-campaign run was captured under: which characterization experiment it belongs to, whether contact was broken since the last run, which pair of points a reciprocity direction used, and what mass was actually on the specimen. State only — it carries no measurement and no judgement, and it exists because the singular measurement_point_id and the repeated-capture shape of this study cannot express a point pair, an attachment, or a mass challenge.

contact_configuration_id.description: One uninterrupted attachment. Runs sharing it were captured without breaking contact; different values mean the contact was remade.

added_mass_g.description: The measured added mass. A nominal value may not stand in for it, which is why the intended figure is a separate field.

acquisition_provenance.description: What a physical acquisition session recorded about itself. Present on a HARDWARE run and absent otherwise: the hardware claim is derived from this record rather than accepted as a caller's label. witnessed_by is the stricter standard — hardware origin says the data came off physical instruments, a witnessed session says the provenance is attributable — and capability promotion follows the stricter one.

raw_artifact_ids.description: Raw measurements retained for this run, including where the run was rejected.
